title: Among all superheroes published by Marvel Comics who are not aligned as 'Go
question: Among all superheroes published by Marvel Comics who are not aligned as 'Good', find the full name of the one with the highest strength attribute value.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_020"
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1."XCL_026" = T2."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN alignment AS T3 ON T1."XCL_027" = T3."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T4 ON T1."XCL_018" = T4."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T5 ON T4."XCL_010" = T5."XCL_003"
WHERE T2."XCL_015" = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND T3."XCL_002" != 'Good'
  AND T5."XCL_004" = 'Strength'
ORDER BY T4."XCL_011" DESC
LIMIT 1

INNER JOIN attribute AS T5 ON T4."XCL_010" = T5."XCL_003"
WHERE T2."XCL_015" = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND T3."XCL_002" != 'Good'
  AND T5."XCL_004" = 'Strength'
ORDER BY T4."XCL_011" DESC
LIMIT 1
